To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the DAF molecule, which is a glycosphingolipid-anchored protein on the cell surface, transduces signals via a DAF-associated protein, DAF-associated protein 43 (DAP43).

the DAF-associated 43 kDa protein, which was identified by a monoclonal antibody (mAb 2E-12-G7) and was named as 43 kDa DAF-associated protein (43DAP), is a transducing molecule in the DAF-associated protein complex.
a protein associated with decay-accelerated factor (DAF), a complement regulatory factor, transduces a tyrosine kinase-dependent signal.
In summary, our research is concerned with
signal transduction by DAF-associated proteins and the elucidation of the mechanism of DAF-mediated signal transduction.
the elucidation of the signal transduction pathway in the GPI-anchored DAF-forming protein complex, which is a unique system for the signal transduction via GPI-anchored proteins.
the signal transduction of a GPI-anchored protein via a protein associated to it.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DAF is associated with 2E12- G7 antigen which transduces a DAF-associated signal.
2E12 antigen, which was identified as a 43 kDa protein in this study, is one of the components of the DAF-associated signal transduction complex, and is involved in signal transduction through DAF.
DAF and 2E12-associated proteins are both signal transducers, and that the signal transduction is mediated by the 1C6 epitope.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DAF-associated 43 kDa protein (2E12-G 7) and DAF transduce signals via tyrosine kinases, and that the signal transducer of DAF-associated 32 kDa protein (3C6) is different from that of 2E 12-G7.
DAF is associated with at least two proteins, 2E12- G7 and DAF-associated 26 kDa protein, which have signal transductions.
DAF-associated 43 kDa protein (2E12-G1) transmits a signal, similar but not identical to that transmitted by DAF, when the DAF molecule associates with 2E12-43 kDa protein.
The main takeaway from our work is that
DAF-associated 43 kDa protein is a novel member of a protein complex which is involved in DAF-associated signaling.
2E12 antigen may be a component of the DAF-form complex and that the 2E12-DAF-forming complex may play a role in signal transduction.
DAF-associated proteins are likely to be involved in the regulation of cell functions.
